plan.summary: This PR documents the new `retries` option in the Requests guide. It adds a Retries section. The section shows the option for TypeScript and Python in tabs. It also imports the Tabs and TabItem components the tabs need.
plan.riskRationale: Documentation-only change to one MDX file. No runtime code changes.
plan.storyArc: The guide gains a Retries section. The tab components are imported first so the per-language examples can render.

topics.title: Retries section with per-language tabs
topics.narrativeBrief: How does the guide document `retries`, and which imports make the tabs work? Verify the TabItem entries render without a label prop and that the examples match the option's real API.
